claims_checks.text: Evaluated ensemble models showed minimal observed sensitivity under No-TTL ablation, below practical materiality.
Linear SVM exhibited greater empirical sensitivity to No-TTL representation change, satisfying materiality criteria.
Primary Autoencoder yielded 0 detections across all 4 evaluated families separately (Backdoor N=583, Worms N=44, Shellcode N=378, Analysis N=677); never implying 0% true sensitivity.
Secondary thresholds recover partial detections accompanied by higher benign false-positive rates; descriptive operating-point trade-off only.
Neither system provides universal zero-day defense; real-world deployment claims strictly avoided.
